provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
product_name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)
version_or_release: v04r01; rolling updates, release family dated June 2024
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of IBTrACS v04r01 / DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16. No netCDF, CSV, shapefile or other dataset bytes were acquired. Future raw work must freeze exact subset, format, retrieval timestamp and file bytes independently.
intended_use: Observed/post-analysed global tropical-cyclone best-track event-history candidate for validation of synthetic catalogues, event identity, basin/frequency/intensity diagnostics and inter-agency uncertainty research. IBTrACS best tracks are not error-free instrumental truth, spatial hazard footprints, vulnerability/loss data or future-climate projections.

licensing.licence_name: NCEI IBTrACS Terms of Use / WDC full and open access; NCEI currently references WMO Resolution 40 for commercial-use guidance
licensing.terms_version_or_date: IBTrACS v04r01 Terms of Use and NCEI v4.01 metadata reviewed 2026-08-10; WMO current general policy context is Resolution 1 (Cg-Ext(2021))
licensing.attribution_requirements: Use the versioned NCEI IBTrACS dataset citation, identify the subset used and access date, and cite the core IBTrACS scientific publication where applicable. Before raw publication, re-check current NCEI product terms, selected source-agency conditions and current WMO policy context.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: No product-specific share-alike requirement is recorded by NCEI for IBTrACS. NCEI's current product terms still reference historical WMO Resolution 40 for commercial-use guidance, while WMO's current general framework is Resolution 1 (Cg-Ext(2021)); future raw review must reconcile the then-current product/source conditions rather than infer rights from either WMO policy alone.
licensing.notes: NCEI currently states that IBTrACS follows WDC full and open access, that contributing RSMC agreements make IBTrACS data open for distribution, and that its product Terms of Use use WMO Resolution 40 as the guide for commercial use. WMO describes Resolution 1 (Cg-Ext(2021), Unified Data Policy) as the comprehensive update building on the earlier Resolutions 40, 25 and 60. The NCEI v4.01 metadata record lists citation/liability constraints rather than a product-specific non-commercial restriction. This is an engineering rights assessment, not legal advice.

redistribution.conditions: NCEI explicitly describes IBTrACS as open for distribution. OpenCatastrophe currently approves metadata only; future raw publication must re-check then-current NCEI IBTrACS Terms of Use, selected source-agency conditions, current WMO policy context, exact subset/format and byte identity.

privacy.notes: The reviewed product is a public tropical-cyclone best-track dataset, not a person-, customer-, policy-, claims- or portfolio-level dataset.

spatial.extent: Global tropical-cyclone basins; exact basin/subset and coordinate semantics must be taken from the selected v04r01 distribution files

temporal.extent: Historical best-track record from the nineteenth century to present with strongly time-varying completeness and a rolling recent/provisional component; exact selected subset and retrieval snapshot must be pinned

variables_and_units.name: storm position
variables_and_units.description: Best-track latitude/longitude positions from multiple contributing agencies; exact field/source semantics depend on the selected distribution and agency columns.

variables_and_units.name: maximum sustained wind speed
variables_and_units.description: Agency/provider-dependent tropical-cyclone intensity estimate. Averaging periods and practices can differ; exact units/conventions must be preserved from selected fields rather than normalized implicitly.

variables_and_units.name: minimum central pressure
variables_and_units.description: Provider-dependent tropical-cyclone intensity parameter where available; exact field/unit/source semantics must be preserved.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval for the rolling v04r01 product family. Raw/derived publication remains blocked until exact subset/format/file byte identities, current NCEI/source terms, current WMO policy context, source conventions, provisional/final status and known issues are independently pinned and reviewed.
